title: docs(pm-dispatch): repo-class governance split, md-content review fork, and the standing 5-card adjudication flow
body:
Fixes #12227
Fixes #12434

Family dispatch (chain head #12227 + folded member #12434), one PR, two per-card commits. Rewrites the pm-dispatch multi-repo/governance text to the repo-class model adopted in the final ruling on the chain head, and codifies the two 2026-08-26 rulings recorded on the member card. File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` only.

## What changed

**Commit 1 — repo classes + amended governance split (chain head, full 6-point scope of the final ruling):**
- **Repo classes**: multi-lane repos (`objectstack`, `objectui`) keep central triage as sole producer of `domain:*`/type/grading; single-lane repos (`cloud`, `objectos`, `hotcrm`, `www.objectos.ai`, future repos by default) self-triage the conflict-free mechanical duties only (own sweep, own `type`, own `finding` first-touch grading; no `domain:*`).
- **Registration is a checklist** (seat post, labels, class assignment, gate inventory) with the admission criterion "does this repo genuinely need a standing seat".
- **Adjudication + cross-repo skills/instruction-surface work sit with the skills seat** in the maintainer-driven human flow (verbatim strokes quoted in 升级与决策).
- **代裁 retained, hard-gated on tier**: measured serving model must equal `claude-fable-5`, machine-read via the downgrade fuse, never self-description; channel runs only on the triage Routine or the skills seat; all other 2026-08-12 confidence-gate conditions stand (gate ⑤ now points at the single home of the tier gate).
- **Cross-repo dedupe/shadow stays central**; **single-lane decision cards queue in the objectstack inbox by default**.

**Commit 2 — the two 2026-08-26 rulings (member card):**
- **md-content review fork** (ACCEPT path fork): a skills-lane PR whose diff contains any `.md` file keeps the governed ending (draft, review-requested, human merge); a code-only skills-lane PR is self-reviewed by the seat at the contract-review tier (checklist unchanged) and landed directly (ready then queue). Scope bounded to the skills lane's own PRs; the Guardrails governed-merge bullet points at the fork.
- **Standing 5-card decision-batch flow**: principle + both verbatim rulings in SKILL.md 升级与决策 (replacing the 回批入口 paragraph it supersedes); batch order, reply format and roll-in detail in `references/decision-analysis.md`.

Ceilings untouched (shrink-only; no raise needed). All new/edited lines respect the 120-byte line rule (gate-verified).

## Cut ledger — every added line paid by a same-file cut

SKILL.md (compression candidates named on the ruling: the five-repo enumeration, the 代扫 exception text; plus the ACCEPT-fork paragraph named on the member card):

| cut | where the content survives |
|:--|:--|
| Five-repo enumeration (三仓依赖链 + 第四仓 objectos + 第五仓 hotcrm narrative) | Replaced by the repo-class definition (the ruling's own compression candidate). Dependency chain kept verbatim; objectos operational facts (no changeset flow, no `packages/`, merge queue live) kept compressed in the same paragraph; hotcrm pointer to `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` kept |
| 2026-08-18 objectos seat-opening quote | Superseded by the 2026-08-26 registration checklist (seat creation is now a standing checklist, not a per-repo ruling); quote survives in git history and on the ruling thread |
| "执行已自 domain:devx 迁出" migration note | Dead history — no operational reader |
| Rule 4 "五仓唯一(仓单即首段五仓)" | "唯一" + class scoping; the class definition in the intro is the single source |
| Rule 4 sister-seat clause "姊妹仓收窄为执行座位(⛔ 不产 domain:*/type/定级)" | Replaced per ruling point 1: 单车道仓席 = 执行座位 + 机械三务自理 (type/grading devolve; domain:* does not) |
| 代扫 rationale "两个分类生产者并存,单一生产者的保障当场归零" | Condensed to "双生产者并存即失守" (named candidate); channel scoped to 多车道仓 |
| "代裁权限唯一归本座位,任何执行座位⛔ 不代裁" | Replaced by the tier-hard-gated channel (2026-08-26 verbatim quote; runners = triage Routine or skills seat) |
| Sweep ② per-repo exemption list ("今日为主仓与 objectui…豁免仅余 cloud、objectos") | Recast in class terms; the repo names survive via the class definition in 多仓协调 |
| Gate ⑤ fable-tier + downgrade-fuse detail | Deduplicated into the section intro's hard gate (single home); ⑤ keeps a pointer |
| 回批入口 paragraph | Folded into 常设决裁流程 (the standing flow it became); the 「处理决策卡」 trigger and the 2026-08-19 no-summary-issue tombstone survive inside the block; the 标准四棱卡面块 cross-reference updated |
| ACCEPT-fork paragraph degenerate wraps ("撤回只/有" single-character lines) | Tightened while inserting the fork (named candidate on the member card); content byte-identical |
| "读五仓代码定落点" / "每日一 fire 跑四仓全量对账" | "全仓" — repo count is no longer an enumerable constant (the 2026-08-20 quote containing 四仓 is verbatim and untouched) |

decision-analysis.md:

| cut | where the content survives |
|:--|:--|
| 出处 anecdote (implementation-view analysis drew a follow-up; business-view ruled on the spot) | The 2026-08-20 quote stays; the lesson is now carried live by the 2026-08-26 「决裁流程今天这样很好…」 confirmation quoted in the main file; story in git history |
| 骨架 "标签就是维护者的收件箱,答复后按四件录裁" | Inbox semantics live in the main file's state model; recording kept as the pointer "录裁与状态转换归主文件「落卡/升级流程」③" |
| Item 5 tail "结尾给低摩擦裁决格式(「回一个字母即可;或『C,但 X』= 自动落到 B」)" | Superseded by the batch reply format (「1A 2B …」 / 「X, 但…」) in the new 常设决裁批流程 section; item 5 keeps a pointer |

- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` — "2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces … and claim no others" (fork prose deliberately avoids glob-shaped spans for non-governed paths)
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — all green
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — green (after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`)
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` — NOT MEASURED locally: it reads the workflow event payload and correctly refuses to run without one; CI owns it
- No changeset: the diff is `.claude/` instruction text only and publishes nothing — `skip-changeset` label applied

## Landing

`.claude/**` is a governed surface and this diff is md-content, so per the md-content fork itself: **draft, human review, maintainer merges by hand**. Do not flip ready, do not queue, do not arm auto-merge.
